info.title: DockerForge API
info.description: DockerForge is a self-hosted web application that simplifies Docker image creation. Users upload their source code, the system auto-detects the language and dependencies, generates an optimized Dockerfile using best-practice templates, builds the Docker image, and lets users download the resulting image as a tar archive.
